data.narrative:
Ayar Labs is a Series E semiconductor company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, currently valued at $3.75B post-money after raising $870M+. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private companies in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, with particular weight on same-stage and adjacent-stage private companies including SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series F), Etched ($5.0B, Series E), Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D), and Nearfield Instruments ($1.6B, Series D).

Two valuation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier to the $3.8B last post-money valuation, implying $5.2B. Peer-median anchoring across 4 same-sector peers yields $3.9B, with a wide range of $1.6B to $11.0B reflecting high dispersion in the frontier semiconductor space. Public comp anchoring cannot be applied due to lack of target revenue disclosure, though the public semiconductor sector median trades at 18.9x price-to-sales.

The triangulated range is $3.3B to $6.0B, with a median of $4.5B. This range sits modestly above the current $3.75B valuation. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory (unmeasurable without disclosure), product commercialization timing, and continued capital availability for this capital-intensive sector. The wide peer range ($1.6B–$11.0B) reflects genuine market uncertainty around competitive positioning in frontier chip development.
